sentences.en: Let's get down to brass tacks and make a decision.
sentences.zh: 咱们直接进入正题，做出决定。

sentences.en: Bronze-ware is largely made from alloys of brass and tin.
sentences.zh: 青铜器主要由黄铜和锡合金制成。

sentences.en: To come down to brass tacks, you owe me something.
sentences.zh: 说到底，你欠我点儿东西。

senses.zh: 黄铜(制品)，黄铜器，铜管(乐器)
